description: Whole cob of blush and cream kernels with bright yellow accents, a pastel cord wrap, peach glass butterfly and yellow and peach beads.

name: Ruby Cob Cherry Charm
description: Tapered cob of glossy ruby-brown kernels with a green cord-wrapped stalk and two red agate cherry beads on knotted green cord.

description: Long cob of mustard yellow, grey and lilac pearly kernels on a dark bamboo stalk, with a pearl, enamel flower plaque and jade gourd.

description: Short cob of pink, peach, slate and amber kernels on a natural stalk, with a gold clasp holding a pale blue bead and white bead.

name: Periwinkle Cob with Clover Beads
description: Long cob of periwinkle, lilac, slate and olive kernels with a blue cord wrap, silver cord and clear clover and blue glass beads.
